title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-20
lineage: SBD > MR > ? > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Mixed‑quality matrix recording of the March 20 1970 show; decent performance of Cold Rain & Snow and a solid Good Lovin' but plagued by confusing track order and uneven sound.
ai_review.review: The tape is a patchwork of soundboard (SBD) and audience (AUD) sources that results in a jumbled listening experience – the first few tracks are muddy while later electric sections, especially Good Lovin', are clear. Musically the highlight is the rare Cold Rain & Snow solo by Jerry, but the overall set suffers from mis‑sequencing and missing material, making it more of a curiosity than a definitive show.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average (few standout moments, many structural issues) while recording quality ranges from poor to fair; combined weighting yields a modest 3‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tracks are a confusing mix of soundboard (SBD) and audience (AUD) recordings. Early tracks are muddy/low quality, later electric sections (e.g., Good Lovin') are clearer. Inconsistent tape sources cause jumps in audio character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is badly sequenced – the middle of the show appears after the opening, with filler from a different date inserted, leading to a disjointed flow that confuses listeners.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice solo on Cold Rain & Snow noted by reviewers.
